fields.name: useSsl
fields.label: Use SSL
fields.helpText: Use secure connection when connection to Transmission

fields.name: urlBase
fields.label: URL Base
fields.helpText: Adds a prefix to the Transmission rpc url, eg http://[host]:[port]/[urlBase]/rpc, defaults to '/transmission/'

fields.name: tvCategory
fields.label: Category
fields.helpText: Adding a category specific to Sonarr avoids conflicts with unrelated non-Sonarr downloads. Using a category is optional, but strongly recommended. Creates a [category] subdirectory in the output directory.

fields.name: tvImportedCategory
fields.label: Post-Import Category
fields.helpText: Category for Sonarr to set after it has imported the download. Sonarr will not remove torrents in that category even if seeding finished. Leave blank to keep same category.

fields.name: tvDirectory
fields.label: Directory
fields.helpText: Optional location to put downloads in, leave blank to use the default Transmission location

fields.name: recentTvPriority
fields.label: Recent Priority
fields.helpText: Priority to use when grabbing episodes that aired within the last 14 days

fields.name: olderTvPriority
fields.label: Older Priority
fields.helpText: Priority to use when grabbing episodes that aired over 14 days ago
